name: team_read
unavailable: The person allows one agent in this chat: there is no team. Do the work yourself.
description: The tree and its room: every agent (name, id, position, parent, state, model, mode, context use, last activity), open slots, subagents that have ended, and the room's messages after `since` that are yours to see — those you sent or received and those of the subagents under you; the main agent sees them all. Messages are numbered: pass the last number you saw as `since` to read only what is new.

since.description: Show messages after this number (default: 0, from the start)
